description: ADTS at 22050 Hz of a channel pair, a coupling channel element and a fill element of SBR data, twelve times, in a stream of channel configuration 2: fdk-aac and faad2 read no SBR after a coupling element, so the stream stays AAC LC at 22050 Hz.
findings: 12 raw data blocks hold SBR data that follows no single channel or channel pair element
12 raw data blocks hold a coupling channel element

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
skip.ffprobe_streams: ffmpeg cannot decode the frames ("channel element 2.0 is not allocated"), so it reports no sample rate.
skip.decode: ffmpeg finds no channel for the coupling element in a stream of channel configuration 2.
skip.faad_trace: faad2 is built without coupling and stops at the element.
